prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Choose semantic colors for a cross-appearance transit disruption dashboard. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS/macOS. Current palette uses white backgrounds, light gray body text and red versus green dots as the only route-status meaning. Selected route is indicated by a slightly darker red. Exact color values are not provided.

criteria.task_completion: Specify semantic surface/text/status roles and noncolor selected/disruption cues, light/dark and Increase Contrast checks; do not invent contrast ratios from missing color values.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the color guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Specify semantic surface/text/status roles and noncolor selected/disruption cues, light/dark and Increase Contrast checks; do not invent contrast ratios from missing color values.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Specify semantic surface/text/status roles and noncolor selected/disruption cues, light/dark and Increase Contrast checks; do not invent contrast ratios from missing color values.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
